description: Reusable authored-pose direction for medic player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies field-treatment and support choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: caring, decisive, efficient, and field-ready, with protected medical supplies, quick triage gestures, and readable tool handling
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's coat, medical bag, satchel, bandages, bottles, tools, insignia, and exact item count. Move exactly one established treatment item at a time; never duplicate supplies, invent a weapon, or alter medical markings.
identity.magicRule: Healing uses the portrait's established medical or restorative palette and originates from a depicted tool, bandage, bottle, or open treatment hand. Keep effects compact and clinical; do not add unrelated arcane runes or offensive elemental magic.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, coat, bag, satchel, bandages, bottles, tools, insignia, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact field-ready healer silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered medic in an attentive triage stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall medic motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, coat, bag, satchel, palette, proportions, insignia, and supply count. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: An alert loop alternates breathing, battlefield scans, bag checks, and a ready open hand while all supplies remain secured.
idle.effectRule: No active treatment effect; a tiny clean glint may appear on one closed instrument.

attentive stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A brisk alternating stride uses real leg compression, one hand stabilizing the bag, free-arm counter-motion, and coat and satchel follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active healing; all supplies remain attached, closed, and singular.

attack.motionDirection: The medic protects the bag, draws exactly one established defensive instrument or bottle, makes a short disabling strike or toss, and immediately secures supplies.
attack.effectRule: Use exactly one portrait-established instrument or bottle with one compact physical impact; no duplicated item, gore, or offensive spell.
frameDescriptions: attentive guard protecting the medical bag
free hand reaches for one established defensive item
exactly one item clears its holder
short planted windup with bag held behind
compact disabling strike or toss at contact

recovered attentive guard

hurt.motionDirection: An impact causes a sharp flinch, backward stagger, protective clutch over the medical bag, low balance catch, self-check, and determined recovery.
hurt.effectRule: One compact impact accent only; no gore, blood, broken supplies, duplicated item, or large healing flash.
frameDescriptions: attentive stance before impact
sharp flinch with forearms protecting chest and bag

forced backward step while bag is clutched close

careful rise with a rapid self-check

recovered determined stance

death.motionDirection: A final impact overwhelms the medic, bag draws close, knees buckle, the body lowers into a sideward collapse, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, broken or duplicated supplies, magic burst, or rigid rotation; preserve coat, bag, and insignia.

cast.motionDirection: The medic opens the bag, selects exactly one treatment item, kneels or braces, applies it with both hands, releases a compact restorative pulse, then reseals the kit.
cast.effectRule: One compact restorative glow may originate from the selected bandage, bottle, tool, or treatment hand; no duplicated supply or anatomy-obscuring aura.

exactly one treatment item is selected

victory.motionDirection: The medic confirms the field is safe, checks the kit, closes it, gives an all-clear signal, makes a relieved hop or shoulder release, and holds a proud caring finish.
victory.effectRule: No spell effect; a tiny clean instrument glint may accent the secured kit.
